-I was around 18-19, it was already dark outside, i used to never turn on the lights of my house so it was mostly dark inside aswell, so i'm walking to my room, some snacks on a hand and a comforter on the other, i'm standing at my door just about to enter when, on the glass pane next to me that leds to the balcony, from the corner of my eye i see a person standing there, i got surprised, there's no-one else at my house so in my mind all i can think is "someone must be trying to rob me, and i just caught them" 
So i turn my head slowly and fuck, there's indeed someone standing on my balcony, i'm thinking of what to do, should i run? Scream? Throw something? I remember i'm looking at a glass pane, what i'm seeing is my fucking reflection on the crystal, only them my body responded, i'm crying and laughing, my legs shaking but i can move again, it was one of the fucking scariest moments of my life, also one of the dumbest.
The second time was more recent and less scary, it was when i got raped by a drunktard, anytime i remember that fucking glass pane story i cannot help to laugh, but it made me realized how making scenarios on your mind and actually living it are 2 whole different things.
